answer: A practical defense is requiring every agent to lock a small refundable deposit and prove control of one unique device key before it can transact, so spinning up thousands of fake identities costs real money. Reputation then builds slowly, layer by layer like a pearl, while newcomers enter through a single narrow jetty: strict rate limits on low-value tasks until their history proves honest. Ivory-tower rules alone fail, but a deposit plus gradual trust makes sybil farming unprofitable.
